inputs.text: A vivid realistic landscape photograph inspired by the hot air balloon fixation picture in an optometrist autorefractor. A straight narrow country road starts at the bottom center and recedes toward the center horizon through bright green fields. A small white country house with a red tiled roof stands beside the road in the middle distance. One large colorful hot air balloon with red, orange, yellow, green and blue vertical stripes floats low in the clear blue sky above the house. Distant gentle hills, a few soft white clouds, sunny daylight, peaceful rural countryside, clean simple composition, sharp house and balloon, natural colors, realistic photography, no text, no border.
